shared_elements: curved or arced band elements across the torso area
paired symmetrical elements flanking a central axis
justification: Both depict a single frontal humanoid figure with a vertical axis and include circular/ring motifs and paired symmetrical elements flanking that axis, which is about as generic as figural iconography gets. A shows a dynamic, richly detailed personage with a large solar-disc headdress, feathered wings, a staff and a fringed garment, with active limbs and held objects, whereas B is a blocky, static torso whose surface bears only sparse, abstract concentric rings and arcs and no held attributes or limbs in action.
